title: Predictive Models of Student Learning Behaviour
summary: A university research project examining student perspectives on institution-wide learning analytics through participatory design, built around the OULAD student dataset. A notebook (Synthesizing_data_set_using_OULAD...) fits an sdv.single_table.GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on the cleaned OULAD data to generate an 8,100-row synthetic student cohort for further analysis. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is directly run via the sdv package to produce this synthetic dataset.
needs: Alistair Morrison is named as project supervisor in the README, not confirmed as an author/contributor in a citation sense; actual student author's name is not given.
